title: How Many Days in the Serengeti?
excerpt: Two nights, three, four or more? How many days you need in the Serengeti depends on your goals. Our honest advice.
body:
The Serengeti is huge, and travelling to it takes time. That is why the number of nights matters.

## One night

Possible, but rushed. You spend much of your time driving in and out. We only recommend it if time is very short.

## Two nights

A good minimum. You have one full day for game drives in one area, usually central Serengeti.

## Three nights

Our most common advice. You have time for two areas, or a relaxed pace in one, with early morning drives and rest in the afternoon.

## Four nights or more

Ideal for photographers, wildlife lovers and anyone following the migration. Combine central Serengeti with the north or south.

## Why more is better

Animals do not follow schedules. The more time you spend, the higher the chance of special sightings: a leopard in a tree, a cheetah hunt or a river crossing.

## Save time

Flying in or out of the Serengeti saves a long drive. See [fly-in safaris](/blog/fly-in-safari/).

## Fit it in

See [how long a Tanzania safari should be](/blog/how-long-safari-tanzania/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
